_comment: Castalia: the tape-out product configuration, and the chip the Genus and Innovus lineage (genus/MCU_WOUND_PENTA, innovus/common/MCU_castalia_penta) is built from. Five harts with orchestrator=true: hart 0 is the always-on soft `orch_tile` in the centre band, keeping the flash/XIP + boot + trap + a0 wiring, and harts 1-4 are uniform hardened corner tiles, all four power-gateable. The peripheral set is the wound-monitoring set (QSPI/I3C/NFC/RTC/PWM/OneWire/DMA/I2CTarget/TRNG/EVFAB, cqAfeStubs dropped, fieldPower/PGOOD live, castalia-lqfp100 package), which makes this the one configuration that instantiates every peripheral config/rdl.json flags, so the register gates run against it. MEMORY MAP v2 rides the hart knobs: SH_AW=16, five read-only TCM apertures at 0x20000 + 0x4000*h, extended flash at 0x40000, so the QSPI/XIP software must use the new flash base. cqAfeStubs=false means the AFE/EIS stub bank does not exist here and the `shorch` catalog row is not selected; `shtcm` is the tape-out-config-capable orchestrator test. numHarts=5 + dma=true means nMasters = 5 harts + DMA = 6 (MW=3). Renamed from config/penta_wound.json on 2026-09-12; chipName stays Castalia, which is what the out-of-tree verify stage and the private analog overlay configs key on. Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/castalia.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia.json
